caption: The drawing depicts a garden scene viewed from above, featuring a heart-shaped garden area outlined with pink and white flowers and green hedges. Inside the heart-shaped section, there are symmetrical paths and additional plantings, as well as two upright statues near the top, and a central statue or decorative element in the middle. The garden sits above a large white ornamental floral urn filled with white flowers and various smaller flowers in shades of pink, yellow, and blue. On either side of the urn, there are water fountains with statues of children or cherubs holding objects, water cascading around them, and light blue water pools at their bases. At the very top of the drawing, there is a white rectangular sign bordered by neatly trimmed trees, with ornate pink writing that reads “Victorian Valerio.” The dominant colors in the composition are green, white, pink, light blue, and beige.
title: Parterre and Fountains of Blind Institution
